questions.prompt: Explain why the perpendicular from the centre of a circle to a chord bisects the chord.
questions.modelAnswer: Let O be the centre and AB the chord, with OM ⟂ AB. In triangles OMA and OMB: OA = OB (radii), OM is common, and ∠OMA = ∠OMB = 90°. So the triangles are congruent by RHS, and by CPCT AM = MB. So M is the midpoint of AB.
rubric: RHS with OA = OB and OM common
